class Dictionary extends null {
  static make(): Dictionary {
    return Object.create(Dictionary.prototype);
  }
  label = "dict";
}
const dictionary = Dictionary.make();
console.log(Object.getPrototypeOf(Dictionary.prototype));
console.log(dictionary instanceof Dictionary, dictionary.label);

class Created extends null {
  constructor() {
    return Object.create(Created.prototype);
  }
}
console.log(new Created() instanceof Created);

try {
  new Dictionary();
} catch (error) {
  console.log(error instanceof TypeError);
}
